page.title: The Smooth Skin Routine
page.body:
Rough, bumpy skin on your legs or arms? Two steps, two ways to exfoliate.

The Smooth Skin Routine pairs two Smooth Sticks (glycolic acid you swipe on and leave on) with the Exfoliating Mitt (just water and friction). Acids loosen dead surface skin; the mitt buffs it away. Together they smooth the look of rough, bumpy skin.

Add the routine to cart: 2 sticks + FREE mitt, $52

What's inside

  • 2 × The Smooth Stick: 7% glycolic acid, 0.5% salicylic acid, 10% shea butter. 18 g / 0.64 oz each.
  • 1 × The Exfoliating Mitt: 100% viscose, elastic cuff, hanging loop. Free with any 2- or 3-stick pack ($14 value).

How to use

  1. Swipe: on clean, dry skin, glide the stick 2–3 times over rough areas. Leave on, no rinse. Start every other evening, then build to daily.
  2. Buff: once or twice a week in the shower, wet the mitt, wring it out and use long strokes with light pressure. Rinse and moisturize.
  3. Use sunscreen on treated areas during the day.

Good to know

Skip broken, irritated or freshly shaved skin, and don't use the mitt and stick on the same evening at first. A light tingle is normal; stop if irritation occurs. Patch test first. For external use only.

Shipping and guarantee

Free US shipping, delivered in 8–16 business days with tracking. Items may arrive in separate packages. 60-day smooth-skin guarantee: if you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund and keep the product.

During our launch, products ship in the manufacturer's original packaging.
